rules.title: Escape output
rules.text: Escape output late with esc_html, esc_attr and esc_url, and sanitize input on entry.

rules.title: Nonces and capabilities
rules.text: Verify nonces and current_user_can for every state-changing action.

rules.title: Prefix globals
rules.text: Prefix functions, hooks and options or use namespaces to avoid collisions.

rules.title: Use hooks, not core edits
rules.text: Extend through actions and filters; never edit core files.

rules.title: WordPress coding standards
rules.text: Follow the WordPress Coding Standards with PHPCS.

rules.title: wpdb prepare
rules.text: Use $wpdb->prepare for every query with variable input.
